title: High-Velocity Inverse Scattering for Nonlinear Schrödinger Equations with Spatially Dependent Nonlinearities
summary: We study a high-velocity inverse scattering problem for nonlinear Schrödinger equations with spatially dependent nonlinearities in dimensions $d\ge3$. We consider the whole mass-supercritical and energy-subcritical range, including the endpoint cases. By introducing a moving frame adapted to highly boosted initial data, we construct the scattering operator for a class of large incoming states generated by Galilean boosts.
